assets.visual_review: Five-rayed petaloid bud, longitudinal grooves, stalk, and open fine brachioles remain legible across top, hero, clay, silhouette, and runtime views.
assets.factual_scope: Pass as named-taxon-inspired teaching art only; nominal scale, color, exact brachiole count and simplified pod anatomy are not specimen claims.
nonblocking_observations: Two smooth-face source prompts (stalk and brachioles) were reviewed in gray/color/runtime evidence and accepted as deliberate soft secondary surfaces around the faceted bud.

external_sources.title: University of Kentucky Geological Survey — Fossil of the month: Pentremites

assets.visual_review: Paired sheaths and jointed axis read clearly in neutral top and oblique views; the shallow host slab remains subordinate and side/front views show relief rather than a flattened whole plant.
assets.factual_scope: Pass as a generalized Schizoneura-inspired preserved shoot/leaf-sheath teaching specimen. The paired-fan simplification is not an exact diagnostic whorl or specimen reconstruction; keep the inspiration/generalization label.
nonblocking_observations: Paired broad fans simplify a more varied fused-leaf sheath arrangement described in palaeobotanical literature; within the frozen teaching-art scope, not a species-level anatomical pass.

external_sources.title: Bomfleur et al. (2013) — A reappraisal of Neocalamites and Schizoneura
external_sources.note: Peer-reviewed reappraisal; full text was unavailable to browser during this review.

assets.visual_review: Continuous mainland, low sediment neck, and offshore island are distinct in hero/reverse/top and runtime views; lower shoreline margins can be followed. The low bed and simplified relief work as a coastal-process teaching tile.
assets.factual_scope: Pass as a process-inspired landform concept without a mapped locality or measured terrain claim. Frozen brief explicitly uses nominal art scale and excludes water and site reconstruction.
nonblocking_observations: One smooth-face prompt on broad landform was reviewed and accepted as deliberate continuous relief; tile is not a surveyed coastal site.

assets.factual_scope: Pass as an interpretive Entobia-like trace concept; no producer species, locality, age, or copied excavated specimen is asserted.
nonblocking_observations: Editable source-only Boolean cutters are present in Blend and excluded from the single exported host mesh as intended.
